analyst_view.overall: Early view: two sides on nine points. Como made history with a 9-1 win at Lens (Douvikas hat-trick) and are fourth, while Real Betis lost 2-1 at Dortmund, where they were outplayed on expected goals (2.58 to 0.82), before winning 2-0 at Elche on Sunday. Betis were without Cucho Hernández and Junior Firpo; Como without Moise Kean, Trevoh Chalobah, Jesús Rodríguez and Assane Diao.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.4 goals. I lean higher: Como have scored 19 in four league-phase games and scored first in each of their first three, and Douvikas has scored in every league-phase game. Betis conceded twice in Dortmund and should have more to do here.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.4 corners. I see no reason to change that: Como score mostly from open play rather than set pieces, and nothing I read suggests Betis will change their approach under Pellegrini.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.9 cards, 2.7 of them Como's. I lean lower: 4.9 is high for two possession-minded sides, and nothing I read points to a disciplinary problem for either team. The referee is still unknown.

shots.text: The numbers say 27.5 shots. I lean slightly higher: Como's attack (Paz, Baturina, Douvikas) has been the most productive in the competition after PSG's, and Betis at home will try to match them rather than sit back.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.1 shots on target. I lean higher, in line with the goals: Como's finishing has been clinical, and Betis's attack (Antony, Ezzalzouli, Isco) should test Butez too.
